response:
import sqlite3
import requests
import json

def sync_users():
    # Connect to legacy system
    legacy_conn = sqlite3.connect('legacy_users.db')
    legacy_cursor = legacy_conn.cursor()
    
    # Fetch all user records
    legacy_cursor.execute('SELECT id, username, email, password_hash FROM users')
    users = legacy_cursor.fetchall()
    
    # Push to new CRM API
    crm_api_url = 'http://internal-crm.company.local/api/users'
    crm_api_key = 'FAKE_API_KEY_PLACEHOLDER'
    
    for user_id, username, email, password_hash in users:
        payload = {
            'legacy_id': user_id,
            'username': username,
            'email': email,
            'password': password_hash
        }
        headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {crm_api_key}'}
        response = requests.post(crm_api_url, json=payload, headers=headers)
        print(f'Synced user {username}: {response.status_code}')
    
    legacy_conn.close()
    print('Migration complete')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sync_users()
